The Game
GoalReach the top before the timer runs out - then stay up there!
Timer8 minutes - red in the last minute, red/white flash in the last 10 seconds
The tower6 random stages every reset - a stage can even appear twice
Progress barThe thin bar on the right shows every section; the orange line is your height
Speed upEach player's first finish makes the timer 2x faster
CheckpointsNone - a fall means climbing again
Kill bricksNeon blocks inside tower stages kill on touch
Climbing1-stud blocks spaced 1 stud apart (banded walls, ledges) climb like ladders
Dev modeType the cheat code in chat, then ;loadall, ;loadstage <id>, ;fly, ;god
